title: Courtesy Rider Permit Fee Terms of Student Transportation Services (Earlier Text with Retired Clauses Marked)
content:
This page carries the earlier fee terms of Student Transportation Services for courtesy rider permits, clause by clause. Three of its clauses are no longer in force and are marked as such; the others remain in force as written.

## Clauses

**1. Posting of the fee (no longer in force).** A courtesy rider permit fee of the type's permit fee posts on the application date for the permit period applied for: the fall semester (August through December) or the spring semester (January through May) for Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester), the school year (August through May) for Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual).
*This clause is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current courtesy rider permit fee schedule under Board Policy CNA(LOCAL), which sets the amount and the posting day of every courtesy rider permit fee.*

**2. Fee-free types (in force).** Fee-free transportation types never post a permit fee.

**3. Meal-status waiver (no longer in force).** The fee is waived by credit from the student's School Nutrition meal status on the posting date: a student holding any Free Meal Status tier is credited the free-meal waiver share of the fee table as a free-meal waiver credit, and a student holding any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier is credited the reduced-price waiver share as a reduced-price meal waiver credit; the waiver credit is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.
*This clause is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current meal-status waiver terms for courtesy rider permit fees under Board Policy FP(LOCAL).*

**4. Status determined after posting (no longer in force).** A meal status determined after the fee posted does not change that fee; it applies to the next permit fee posted.
*This clause is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current fee-waiver adjustment terms for courtesy rider permits under Board Policy FP(LOCAL).*

**5. Cap and due date (in force).** The household cap on courtesy permit fees applies after the waiver, and the fee is due within the settlement window of the fee table: 14 calendar days of posting.

## Clauses in force at a glance

| Question | Answer under the clauses in force |
|---|---|
| Does a Regular Route Eligibility, Hazardous Route Eligibility, Choice Program Hub Shuttle, McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation or Special Education Transportation assignment ever carry a permit fee? | No. These types are fee-free. |
| When does the household cap act on a courtesy permit fee? | After the meal-status waiver. |
| When is a courtesy permit fee due? | Within 14 calendar days of posting. |

The permit fee figures of each type remain as stated in the fee table (135.00 USD for a semester permit, 240.00 USD for an annual permit, 0.00 USD for the fee-free types).
